programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Vegas Golden Knights host the Anaheim Ducks for Game 1 of the Western Conference Second Round at T-Mobile Arena. The Ducks advanced to this round by defeating the Oilers 4-2, while the Golden Knights eliminated the Mammoth with a 4-2 victory.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Ducks take on the Golden Knights at T-Mobile Arena for Game 2 of the West second round. Vegas leads the series after a 3-1 Game 1 win. Mitch Marner had a 162-foot empty-netter and an assist. Carter Hart was sensational, stopping 33 of 34 shots.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The West second round Game 3 gets underway as the Golden Knights play the Ducks at Honda Center. The series is tied. Anaheim used speed to stifle Vegas, with Jansen Harkins sealing the Game 2 win with an empty-net goal with 3:30 remaining.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Ducks face the Golden Knights in Game 4 of the West second round at Honda Center. The Golden Knights lead 2-1 after a 6-2 Game 3 win. In Game 3, Mitch Marner had a historic performance, recording his first playoff hat trick and four points.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: Jack Eichel leads the Golden Knights against Leo Carlsson and the surging Ducks in Game 4 with the series that is tied 2-2. After Anaheim's 4-3 victory in the last outing, Vegas relies on Jack Eichel's 10 postseason points to reclaim the series lead.

programs.title: NHL Hockey
programs.desc: The Golden Knights visit the Ducks for a crucial Game 6 of the Western Conference round. Pavel Dorofeyev scored 2 goals along with the game-winning goal in matchround 5 . Following an overtime loss in last match, the Knights lead this series 3-2.
